title: Sprightly (Font addon)
body:
As some people may not like/prefer the Sprightly font, I decided to make it an optional addon!
The Sprightly font is based on small personal preferences and fits right into any of the other Sprightly packs! 

This Font pack may also work in any other scenario! 


All official sprightly "addons/packs":

Sprightly,

Sprightly (only the gui),

Sprightly (Font addon)
